note: 此刻那一本主线节点原画的场面稿，头一轮（每条主线一幅）下半：#1185 到 #1199。

nodes.name: 夹盔礼
who: the golden-haired knight in the dark blue surcoat
nodes.light: a cold pale ring of light spreading across the night sky from the great bell above, against blue-black shadow, with small grey flames in stone lamps along the street
nodes.camera: low on the street in front of the tomb gate, close behind the living knight's right shoulder, looking up at the dead knight and the bell tower above her; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night in a city of tombs built of pale bone-coloured stone. Its roofs are steep slate spires, round bell turrets and low domes, each topped with a plain stone ball, a sharp point or a small bronze bell; the tombs are flat-topped vaults and pillars crowned with stone urns and bells; nowhere on any roof, tomb or gate is there a cross. A huge bell tower rises out of the top of the picture and is cut off by the frame; its great bell has just swung, and one wide ring of pale light is spreading outward through the sky from it like a ripple. At the foot of the tower a tall tomb gate stands open on darkness, and down its steps, toward us, has walked a dead woman knight who looks twenty-two: a face so white that the cheekbones show, pale flaxen hair tied low at the nape, eyes with pupils that do not quite focus, her head tilted a little to one side to see. She wears a full suit of old-fashioned legion plate armour, dulled with age, with a single large bell engraved on the breastplate. She faces us and stands at attention: her helmet is tucked under her left arm, and her right fist is pressed against the engraved bell on her chest in a soldier's salute. Her sword is sheathed at her hip. All around her feet the paving stones of the street are heaving up, and here and there the bony heads and forelegs of skeleton warhorses are pushing through the cobbles from below: true horse skeletons, with long narrow horse skulls, flat blunt horse teeth and no fangs, and forelegs that end in round hooves, never claws or paws. In the near foreground on the right, seen directly from behind, stands the golden-haired knight in the dark blue surcoat and steel plate, thick wavy warm-gold hair over her pauldrons, her right hand closed on the hilt of her sword, which is still in its scabbard at her hip so that no blade shows, and her left hand lifted a little, open, as if to steady someone. Grey ash-like motes and pale sparks drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕阶段①：钟多响了一声，战死多年的艾尔莎夹着头盔走出墓门敬礼，骷髅战马从街面底下钻出来。发色卡里没写，补成浅亚麻色。她是亡灵，脸白，不画烂。

nodes.name: 画外手
who: the violet-haired mage in the black and white robe
nodes.light: flat bright noon sun from straight above on a silent street, with short sharp violet shadows, and a cooler, paler light inside the painting
nodes.camera: at shoulder height on the street, close behind the mage's right shoulder, looking straight at the painting on the wall; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: high noon in a city of mirrors and gabled dream-theatres, and the whole city is asleep. Along the street people have dropped off where they were: a waiter sits slumped at a cafe table, a lamplighter sleeps against his post, a child is curled on a doorstep, all peaceful, all breathing. On a plastered wall on the right hangs a large framed street painting, taller than a person, showing another street in soft brushwork. Out of that painting, at its middle, a girl leans toward us, facing us: a young dream-demon woman of twenty, plainly a girl, with a soft round girlish face, large gentle ink-grey eyes with long lashes, a small mouth and slender shoulders; a short violet-grey bob that curls in at her jaw, three paintbrushes tucked behind one ear, two very small dark horns at her hairline, a paint-stained painter's smock with long sleeves over a plain dress. Her body from the waist down and her left hand are still inside the picture, painted in visible brush strokes and a little paler than the real world; her right arm reaches straight out of the canvas into the real air, the hand open and held out toward us, and where the arm crosses the surface of the canvas the brush strokes turn into real cloth and skin. Her face is calm and serious; she is not crying. At the corners of the painting small black blots of ink are swelling into shapes with claws. In the near foreground on the left, seen directly from behind, stands the violet-haired mage in the black and white robe, long straight violet hair down her back; her right hand is lifted and reaching toward the offered hand, and their fingertips are a hand's width apart. Her left hand holds her staff upright. Flecks of wet colour and bright dust drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕阶段①开头：正午整座城睡了过去，米拉贝尔从街头的画里伸出手，手伸得笔直，没有哭。画里的她轮廓比外头淡一层。梦魔的小角是照魔族各系都有角补的。

nodes.name: 掌贴鲸伤
who: the grey-blue-haired wyvern rider in the long leather flight coat
nodes.light: low amber dusk sun from the left under a bank of storm cloud, with cool slate-blue shadow on the whale's flank and a dim blue crystal glow along its wound
nodes.camera: low on the whale's side, close to the two people standing on it, looking along the huge curve of the flank toward the tower; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: dusk at a docking port near the top of a black stone tower that stands above the clouds. A sky whale has crashed across the port: an animal as long as a street, slate-blue above and pale beneath, with long fins like sails; its body lies across the broken docking platforms and fills most of the picture, cut off by the frame at both ends, with snapped mooring masts and a fallen crane under it. One of its great eyes, half closed, shows on the right. Along its flank runs a long pale gash edged with dim blue crystal light, clean and bloodless, where half of the crystal inside it was torn away. On the slope of the flank beside that gash stands a small winged girl of sixteen, a night-wing: a pair of large deep teal wings folded at her back, the tip of one notched by an old injury long healed, wind-tangled hair, a rope-handler's padded long-sleeved jacket and trousers. She stands in full profile facing right toward the gash, with her left palm laid flat on the whale's skin beside it, and she looks at the whale's eye; she is unhurt. Her right hand reaches back and grips the sleeve of the man standing just behind her. He is the grey-blue-haired wyvern rider in the long leather flight coat: lean, windswept steel-grey-blue hair tied at the nape, grey eyes. He faces us and looks up over our heads at the sky, his left arm held out a little to her by the sleeve she grips and his right hand resting on his belt. In the sky behind them, small and dark, circle five glider-troops of the air pirates. Shreds of torn sailcloth and flecks of blue light drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕阶段①：受伤的天空鲸撞上塔港，琪珀把手贴在伤口旁边，攥住一个人的袖子不肯撒手。琪珀十六岁，照未成年画，翼尖的缺口是旧伤。鲸的伤口不画血。

nodes.name: 举镣引雷
who: the huge grey-skinned half-orc in dark plate
nodes.light: blinding blue-white lightning from the tower top above, flickering down wires over the whole city, against black storm cloud and wet iron
nodes.camera: low in the prison yard, close in front of the young guard, looking steeply up past her at the tower and the lightning; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a night of thunderstorm over a prison city built entirely of black iron: tiers of cell blocks, catwalks, and a web of heavy wires strung from four tall towers. On the very tip of the north tower, high in the upper middle of the picture, stands a small far figure of an old troll in rags, both wrists locked in welded fetters; he holds the chain of his fetters stretched above his head in both hands, and the whole sky's lightning is pouring down in one trunk onto that chain. From the tower the lightning runs on along every wire of the city in branching blue-white lines, down into the cell blocks, and all along the tiers hundreds of cell doors are bursting open at the same instant, light flaring from every doorway. Far behind the blocks, half hidden in rain and cut off by the frame, a shape as big as a hill is stirring in chains: one shoulder and a bowed head of a giant. In the foreground, facing us, a young woman jail guard of twenty has just stopped in mid-run out of the block gate: a horned demon-kin woman with a pair of short bull-like horns, the left one worn shiny, a thick braid down her back, a jailer's leather armour buttoned to the top, arms thicker than most men's. Her right hand grips a large ring of keys at her hip; her left arm points straight back behind her at the blocks; her mouth is open, shouting a count. On the left, seen directly from behind, stands the huge grey-skinned half-orc in dark plate, two heads taller than she is, looking up at the tower with both fists closed at his sides. Rain and blue sparks streak large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕阶段①：托巴尔在北雷塔塔尖举镣引雷，全城牢门同一刻弹开，风暴巨人醒了。欣德二十岁，牛魔短角，腰上一串钥匙。巨人只露一角。

nodes.name: 灯街浮海
who: the tall sea-folk ship's doctor in the white surgeon's coat
nodes.light: rows of small warm yellow lamps burning out on the black sea behind the girl, against deep blue night, with one harbour lantern lighting the pier from the right
nodes.camera: low on the pier, close in front of the running girl, looking past her down the whole length of the lit street on the water to the horizon; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night at a fishing pier under the sea wall of a dark blue coastal fortress. Out on the black sea beyond the pier something has risen: a long drowned street, its wet paving just under the surface, running straight away from us to the horizon, and along both its sides old stone lamp-posts stand out of the water and are lighting one after another into the distance, two endless rows of small yellow flames. Down that street toward the pier, small and far, ride five deep-sea knights in armour of coral and shell on great rays that skim the surface, throwing up spray. In the middle of the pier, facing us, a sea-folk girl of eighteen has just come to a stumbling stop: hair cut below the ears with white salt crusted at the tips, faint gill lines on the sides of her neck, a fisher's long-sleeved smock and rolled trousers, bare feet on the wet planks. On her back, like a basket of fish, she carries a bundle wrapped in three layers of fishing net, and through the net shows a dull coral-red glow. Both her hands grip the net straps at her shoulders. Her eyes are wide; she is out of breath. On the right, kneeling on the pier in full profile facing left, is the tall sea-folk ship's doctor in the white surgeon's coat: short messy blue-black hair with a small star ornament, a calm strong face turned up toward the girl in surprise. Her right hand holds a curved needle and thread; her left hand steadies the bandaged forearm of a sailor who sits on a crate at the right edge, mostly cut off by the frame. Drops of spray and yellow lamp-glints drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕阶段①：王冠进网那一夜，外海浮起一条沉了的长街，街灯一盏一盏亮到天边，深海骑士顺着街追珊蒂，她撞到正在缝伤口的薇赛拉跟前。月夜不写。珊蒂十八岁。

nodes.name: 门前
who: the young saintess in white robes with a thin gold circlet
nodes.light: pale gold light from the eyes and the seams of the rising guardian on the right, against the deep blue dark of an underground hall, with a soft white glow from the saintess's staff
nodes.camera: a wide side view from low on the floor of the hall, the students on the left and the guardian on the right, looking up so that the guardian is cut off by the top of the frame; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a vast underground hall that no one built for the academy above: square pillars, a floor of worn star-patterned tiles, dust hanging in the air. On the far right, cut off by the edge of the picture, stands a colossal door of dark stone inlaid with small pale stars. In front of the door, on the right half of the picture, an ancient guardian is rising from the stone seat where it has sat for ages: a giant of stone and tarnished brass shaped like an armoured knight, five times the height of a person, cut off at the shoulders by the top of the frame. Dust and chips pour off it; pale gold light shines from the slit of its helm and from the seams of its joints. Its left hand holds upright a long polearm whose head is shaped like the bit of a great key. It faces left, toward the people, in full profile. On the left half of the picture stands a tight group of five students of about eighteen in matching academy uniforms with long coats, all in full profile facing right, all unhurt: among them, nearest to us, a small healer girl with her hair tied back very tight, holding diagonally in both arms a healing staff taller than herself, a bandage pouch at her belt, frightened and holding her ground. One step in front of the group, between them and the guardian, in full profile facing right, stands the young saintess in white robes with a thin gold circlet: soft golden hair past her shoulders, amber eyes lifted to the guardian's helm. Her right hand holds her staff planted upright, its head glowing white; her left arm is stretched straight back, palm open toward the students, keeping them behind her. Dust motes and gold sparks drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕阶段③：古代守门人醒了，把学生当成闯入者，菲奥娜站到最前面，身后没有圣堂。临时小队五个人，艾米在里头。学生照未成年的画法，不带伤。守门人的样子卡里没写，补成石和铜的巨像，钥匙头的长柄。

nodes.name: 第一枚
who: the crimson-haired mage in the black battle coat
nodes.light: red-orange light from fire raining out of the sky on the left, cut by the cold blue-white of a wall of ice across the street on the right, under a night sky full of storm
nodes.camera: low in the middle of the avenue, close in front of the technician, looking up the street at the towers and the sky; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night in a ring-shaped city of slender towers joined by glowing conduits. Seven taller towers stand in a circle on the skyline, and from each of them a different light is pouring out of control: fire is raining down in burning streaks over the district on the left, a jagged wall of ice as tall as the houses has burst up across the avenue on the right and cut it in two, wolf-shaped beasts made of lightning are running along the rooftops, and a funnel of storm cloud turns above the central tower in the far background. Citizens are fleeing down a side street, small and far. In the middle of the avenue, facing us, stands a woman technician of twenty-seven: short deep-blue hair with one lock on the left side scorched white, work overalls with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, forearms marked with old burns in several faded colours, and an iron ring hung with six plain keys on a cord round her neck. Her right hand is raised to the height of her face and holds up a seventh key that glows red-hot like a coal, just won; her left hand is lifted with the forearm across her brow, shielding her eyes from the falling fire. Soot streaks her face; her look is tired and unbending. Behind her on the ground lies the burnt-out shell of a great beast of fire, already breaking up into embers. On the left, seen directly from behind, stands the crimson-haired mage in the black battle coat, long straight crimson hair, both arms raised above her head with the palms up, holding a wide flat disc of pale blue light over the two of them like a roof; the fire streaks burst against it. Embers and ice splinters streak large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕阶段①：元素核心同一夜失控，火雨、冰墙、雷兽，吉赛儿在火焰区打倒头一头元素兽，拿到第一枚核心钥匙。吉赛儿二十七岁，左边一绺头发叫元素火燎白。

nodes.name: 夺旗
nodes.light: bright midday sun from the upper left on white stone and pale sand, with sharp blue shadows, and a dull black lance that seems to swallow the light around it
nodes.camera: from the front row of the stands, close behind the squire's shoulder at the rail, looking down across the sand at the knight in the middle; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: midday in the great tournament arena of a city of white stone, on the day of the final: tiers packed with a crowd on its feet, long white pennants along the walls, pale raked sand. In the middle of the sand, facing us, stands a knight in full black plate armour from head to foot, his helm closed so that no face shows. In his left hand he holds, gathered by one corner, the great white city banner he has just torn from its pole, a plain white cloth with a single blue bird-of-prey emblem, trailing on the sand. In his right hand he holds a long black lance with its point resting on the ground beside him; the air close to the lance is dim, as if it drank the light. He stands quite still. Around him on the sand eight tournament champions in bright polished armour of many colours have been struck down: they sit or kneel, dazed, helmets off, shields and broken lances scattered, none of them bleeding. Behind him at the far gate, small and half in shadow, four riders in dark mail on black wolves are slipping out of the arena with the bare banner pole. In the near foreground on the left, seen directly from behind, a young squire of nineteen leans over the rail of the stands: gold-red hair cut at the jaw and tied with a leather cord, a grey-white trainee's surcoat worn fuzzy at the elbows, a plain short sword at her hip. Her left hand grips the rail; her right hand holds a small open notebook and a stub of pencil. Her head is turned not toward the black knight but toward the riders at the far gate. Dust and glints of sun drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕阶段①：黑甲骑士闯进竞技场挨个击倒冠军夺走城旗，满场的人都去看决斗，塞拉盯的是他的部下把旗弄到哪儿去了。黑甲的头盔不摘（他是谁不点破）。莱恩哈特没进画。

nodes.name: 翅影
who: the small halfling cook with curly honey-blonde hair
nodes.light: hot gold afternoon sun from the left over ripe wheat, broken by one vast cool shadow that falls across the whole field from the right, with a glitter of gold on the swarm
nodes.camera: low among the wheat ears, close to the two figures on the left, looking across the field and up at the thing rising on the right; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a harvest afternoon on a plain of ripe wheat that runs to the horizon like a golden sea, with a granary city of round towers small in the far distance. On the right, the earth of the field has burst open, and out of it rises the queen of the locusts: an insect as large as a hill, armoured in plates of dull gold, her wings spread so wide that they are cut off by the top and the right side of the frame and their shadow lies across half the field. Around her the air glitters with a cloud of small gold locusts, and where the cloud has passed the wheat stands as empty grey husks. On a cart road through the middle distance a line of harvest wagons drawn by oxen, piled with sheaves, is trying to get away, the drivers small and standing in their seats. In the foreground on the left, standing in the wheat in full profile facing right toward the queen, is a farm girl of eighteen: sun-reddened cheeks, a peeling nose, a straw hat with a frayed brim pulled low, a long-sleeved linen blouse and a long skirt with an apron. Her right hand holds low at her side an old sickle, its blade black with age and nicked in three places; her left hand holds the brim of her hat against the wind of the wings. Her feet are planted; her jaw is set. Beside her, nearer to us and also in full profile facing right, stands the small halfling cook with curly honey-blonde hair, barely reaching the girl's elbow, in a cream blouse, berry-red vest and long white apron; she holds a heavy iron frying pan raised in both hands like a club. Wheat chaff and bright gold wings streak large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕阶段③：蝗后破土而出，翅影盖住麦海，收割的车队还在田里。梅露十八岁，祖母传下来的镰刀有三个旧缺口。派派拿一口铁锅。

nodes.name: 跳板
who: the white-haired wood-elf archer in the pale hunter's coat
nodes.light: pale blue-green lantern light from the deck of the ghost ship above on the right, against the black of midnight water, with one warm harbour lamp behind on the left
nodes.camera: low on the pier at the foot of the gangplank, looking up along it at the ship's side and the figures at the rail; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: midnight at a stone pier of a great harbour. A ruined sailing ship has come alongside without a sound: her hull grown thick with barnacles and weed, her sails hanging in pale rags, cold mist pouring over her rail and down her side, pale blue-green lanterns burning along her deck. She towers over the pier and is cut off by the top and the right side of the frame. A worn gangplank slopes from the pier up to her deck. At the top of the hull, along the rail, stand the dim pale shapes of her crew, a dozen still figures in old sailors' coats with their faces lost in mist; one of them, an older broad-shouldered man near the head of the gangplank, stands a little apart and looks straight down at the pier. On the gangplank, in full profile facing right toward the ship, a young woman of twenty-one has just set her right foot on the plank: short hair stiff with salt, a pencil tucked behind her right ear, a harbour-tower uniform coat washed pale, plain trousers and boots. Her right hand grips the rope rail of the gangplank. Her left arm is raised in front of her chest, and on that wrist a small brass navigation instrument, like a compass with a turning ring, glows and points up at the ship. She looks up at the older man at the rail, her eyes wide and unblinking. She carries no rope and no lamp. On the pier behind her on the left, also in full profile facing right, stands the white-haired wood-elf archer in the pale hunter's coat: chin-length silvery white hair, long pointed ears, a long bow held undrawn in her left hand at her side and her right hand reaching back to her quiver. Mist and green lantern-glints drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕阶段①：午夜幽灵船靠岸，海莉只带了腕上的导航仪冲上去，船上有她失踪多年的父亲。父亲只画成栏边一个看着她的影子。海尸没画。

nodes.name: 碎穹
who: the black-haired presiding judge in black and gold robes
nodes.light: one hard shaft of white daylight falling through the broken dome in the middle, full of glittering glass, against the black polished stone and violet shadow of the hall
nodes.camera: low on the courtroom floor in front of the dock, close to the girl and the young dragon, looking up at the shattered dome and the high bench behind them; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: day in the great courtroom of a tribunal built of black glass and black stone: tiers of benches, tall narrow windows, and a high glass dome that has just been smashed through; a shaft of white daylight comes down through the hole, and shards of glass are still falling in it like rain. On the floor below, in front of the wooden defendant's dock, a young black wyvern has crash-landed: a small dragon about the size of a horse, with bat-like wings, one wing folded tight and the other held awkwardly half open, its head low, its eyes wide with fear. Crouched against its neck, facing us, is its rider, a dragonkin girl of seventeen: a few dark fine scales at her temples and on the backs of her hands, flying goggles pushed up on her forehead, two wind-reddened streaks on her cheeks, a short leather riding jacket with old dragon scales sewn on as shoulder guards over a long-sleeved shirt, long trousers and boots. Her left arm is wrapped round the wyvern's neck; her right hand is pressed flat over a small leather pouch that hangs on her chest. She is unhurt, and she glares up at the hole in the dome. Through that hole, high above, three grey stone gargoyles with knives are diving in, small against the light. In the background, in the middle, behind the high judge's bench, stands the black-haired presiding judge in black and gold robes, facing us: a long straight high ponytail, grey-blue eyes, a pale exact face. Her right hand rests on a gavel on the bench; her left hand is raised, palm out, toward the guards at the doors. Splinters of glass and motes of light drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕阶段①：幼年黑色飞龙撞穿审判庭的穹顶，凯娜护着幼龙，石像鬼刺客追下来，胸口皮袋里是那片龙鳞。凯娜十七岁，照未成年画，不带伤。蒙塔古递鉴定书那一下没画。

nodes.name: 掀车
who: the rose-gold-haired sword-captain in the white and gold coat-gown
nodes.light: bright spring sun from the upper left through a rain of petals, with soft rose-pink shadows, and a cold green-black shade under the giant thorns
nodes.camera: low in the street, close to the overturned float, looking past the sword-captain and up the avenue at the palace wrapped in thorns; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a bright day of the flower festival in a royal capital of pale stone: garlands across the streets, petals falling everywhere. At the far end of the avenue, giant thorn briars as thick as towers have burst out of the ground and wound themselves round the whole royal palace; the highest tower, wrapped to its top in dark thorns, rises against the sky and is cut off by the top of the frame. Down the avenue, between the palace and us, creatures made of petals and thorny stems, shaped like tall thin dancers, are drifting among abandoned stalls. In the foreground a big festival float heaped with roses has gone over on its side. In full profile facing right, the rose-gold-haired sword-captain in the white and gold coat-gown stands bent at the knees with both hands under the edge of the float, lifting it: long rose-gold hair pinned up with a braided gold crown, a calm strong face tight with effort. The long skirt of her coat-gown has been torn off evenly at the shin so that she can move, showing white trousers and tall brown boots beneath: she has exactly two legs, the front knee bent and the other leg stretched straight back, each ending in one tall brown boot, and nothing else shows under the skirt; the torn strip of cloth lies on the paving behind her; her thin ceremonial sword stays sheathed at her hip. Under the lifted edge two townspeople are pulling a third man out by the arms; he is dusty, unhurt and wide-eyed. On the paving near her front foot lies an empty sword scabbard worked with golden roses, dropped and forgotten. Rose petals and specks of pollen drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕阶段①：花祭上巨大的荆棘围住王宫，伊索尔德撕开礼服下摆去搬倒下的花车，有人捡到公主留下的玫瑰剑鞘。公主没进画。地方参考用露玫城全景。

nodes.name: 水上门
who: the dark-haired night-folk girl with a thin braid at each cheek
nodes.light: cool silver dusk light off a perfectly still lake, with a deeper blue sky, and a pale glow coming up from under the water
nodes.camera: low on the shore, close to the kneeling girl on the right, looking out across the mirror of the lake at the lone gate; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: dusk on the shore of a wide, perfectly still lake beside a silver-roofed royal city; the water is a flawless mirror. Out on the lake, in the middle of the picture, a single tall arched gate of silver stone stands on the surface with nothing behind it but mist. Yet in the water beneath it the reflection shows much more than the gate: a whole palace of towers and halls hangs downward into the depth, upside down, lit from within, where no palace stands above. In the open arch of the gate stands a tall figure in the long robes and mantle of an ancient king, facing us: where his face should be there is only a smooth blank surface like polished silver, with no eyes, nose or mouth. He is bowing slightly toward the shore. In his right hand he holds up a round silver hand-mirror turned toward us, and in that mirror shows the small clear face of a young woman with mist-blue hair in a single braid; his left hand rests on the edge of the gate's door, drawing it shut. A small empty rowing boat drifts halfway between the gate and the shore, its oars trailing. On the shore in the foreground on the right, kneeling at the water's edge in full profile facing left toward the gate, is the dark-haired night-folk girl with a thin braid at each cheek: short black hair with a blue sheen, dark red eyes, fine white skin, a travelling coat buttoned to the neck. Her right hand has just lifted out of the water a dripping pendant on a chain, a small round mirror in a silver rim; her left hand is braced on a wet stone. She stares at the gate. Drops of water and silver motes drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕阶段①：宫门口站着无面的昂瑟兰，银镜里照着菲尔娜的脸，他朝岸上鞠了一躬把门关上，只有吊坠漂回岸边。王宫只在倒影里。月镜不写月字。地方参考用银湖城全景。

nodes.name: 离塔
who: the lion-eared war chief with a mane of golden-brown hair and an eyepatch
nodes.light: bright cold highland sun from the upper left on bronze bells and white stone, against dark blue-grey storm cloud boiling up out of the canyon below on the right
nodes.camera: at the height of the parapet on the tower top, a little behind the leaping girl, looking out over the edge and down into the canyon; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a windy day on the top of a tall white tower in a city on a high plateau; hundreds of small bronze wind bells hang in rows from its eaves and posts, all streaming sideways in the wind. Beyond the parapet the ground falls away into an enormous canyon full of dark storm cloud, floating rocks and flickers of lightning. Far out over the canyon, small against the cloud, a pirate airship with ragged sails is running away, and under its hull, in a rope sling, hangs a huge pale egg. In the middle of the picture, at the instant after leaving the parapet, a beast-eared cat girl of seventeen is in the air in full profile facing right, her body stretched out level: grey-and-white cat ears on top of her head, a copper ring in the left ear, a short courier's cape to the waist, a fitted long-sleeved jacket, trousers and laced boots. On her back, strapped tight, is an old glider wing of patched canvas on a mended wooden frame, already spread and filling with wind; both her hands grip its control bar in front of her chest, and her feet have just left the stone, toes pointing back. At her belt hangs a string of small bells with their clappers wrapped in cloth. Her eyes are fixed on the airship and her teeth are set; she is unhurt. On the tower top on the left, in full profile facing right, stands the lion-eared war chief with a mane of golden-brown hair and an eyepatch: tall and strong, a studded leather cuirass over a rust-red tunic. His right arm is still stretched out after her with the hand open, having just let go of the glider's tail; his left hand grips a bell post. Below the parapet two small fallen scouts of the pirates lie tied with rope. Loose feathers and bronze glints streak large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕阶段①：琪可背上滑翔翼从风铃塔上一跃而下，空盗带着蛋往峡谷里跑。琪可十七岁，照未成年画。风铃信标的铃舌拿布缠着。

nodes.line: 会吃魔法书的黑色幼龙
nodes.name: 吞书
who: the small silver-haired elf mage with two long tails of hair
nodes.light: warm honey-coloured lamp light from brass reading lamps on the left, against the brown dusk of tall shelves, with a small violet glow around the little dragon
nodes.camera: low between two rows of shelves, level with the seated elf, looking up at the ladder and the little dragon above; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: inside a great castle library: shelves of old books rise out of sight on both sides, with rolling ladders, brass reading lamps and narrow galleries. High in the middle of the aisle hovers a black dragon whelp no bigger than a hand, with tiny bat-like wings and bright eyes; it clings to the top edge of a thick open spell-book that floats in the air, and it is eating the book: the pages are coming apart into streams of black ink and violet light that pour into its small jaws. The pages show only blots and swirls, no writing. On a rolling ladder on the right, in full profile facing left toward the whelp, stands an apprentice librarian of eighteen: a dark blue apron with a paper knife and three bookmarks in its pocket over a long-sleeved dress, half-rim spectacles slipping down her nose, her hair pinned up with a pen. Her left arm is stretched out as far as it will go toward the little dragon; her right arm hugs a tall stack of books against her chest. Her mouth is open in dismay. On the floor of the aisle below, three open books lie face up, and out of each one a knight folded from blank cream paper with ink-black edges is climbing, knee-high, lance first. At the lower left, sitting on a low library step-stool and facing us, is the small silver-haired elf mage with two long tails of hair: long pointed ears, calm pale-green eyes lowered to the book that lies open in her two hands in her lap. She is reading and has not looked up; a staff leans on the shelf beside her. Flecks of gold dust and curls of violet ink drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕阶段①：巴掌大的黑色幼龙吞禁咒书，艾薇抱着一摞书追，纸甲骑士从书里跳出来。芙莉莲坐在一边看书。书页不画字。芙莉莲的立绘标了看上去未满十八，照那一条画。
